role: independent research contributor; central Amalgam controls native integration
question: Can a generic 1/2/3-parent Boolean learner generalize to full 5-bit action combinations withheld from ALL training and selection, and outperform a direct flat action table without claiming generalization to unseen true-parent bit configurations?
precedent: Gate17 fit and held rounds each used all 32 intervention vectors. That establishes new noisy outcomes on familiar actions, not truly withheld-action transfer. Gate17 also tied an equal-state fixed learner.

predeclared_worlds.intervention_split: For each seed/context, generate one deterministic uniformly shuffled permutation of all 32 action IDs, independent of true parent mask/table/labels. First 24 are the ONLY allowed training actions. Final 8 are strictly held, absent from any fit/validation stage. Check exact disjoint sets and 24+8 coverage on every world.
predeclared_worlds.training: 96 intervention-response events per world from four independently shuffled 24-action rounds, each allowed action observed four times with independent visit-indexed output noise; first64 selected for candidate fitting and final32 for training-only validation. No held labels or actions used for fitting.
predeclared_worlds.held: One outcome for each of the 8 unseen actions from disjoint held noise domain. Separate per-parent-bin coverage analysis uses the hidden true parent mask FOR EVALUATION ONLY.
predeclared_worlds.source_family: Reuse the exact Gate17 generator for majority-of-three, 3-bit MUX, essential random 3-parent truth table, parity3, pair XOR, unary copy and fair-independent labels with fixed 5% sensor flips for all nonrandom sources.
predeclared_worlds.negative_identifiability: If a 3-parent input pattern is absent from ALL fit actions, the corresponding arbitrary Boolean truth-table cell is not identified by observations. Report such cases separately and prove an exact indistinguishable paired truth-table counterexample. Never claim identification of unobserved parent patterns.

arms.adaptive: Gate17 generic Boolean conditional table on selected 1/2/3-input parent subsets; same LOO+parameter penalty + training-only validation and triggered 3-way subset expansion. 96 training x/y records; no operator labels/parents exposed.
arms.fixed_full: Same 388-byte compact saved evidence and same selection/forecast as adaptive, always evaluates all 3-way masks and retains comparable route. Decisive negative/control for unique self-assembly.
arms.truncated: Gate17 <=2 parent subsets, exact same 96 observed fit rows.
arms.flat: Laplace smoothed 32-action lookup table. Each held full action is NEW, so predicts 0.5 for it. This is a strong non-generalizing memorization negative control.
arms.parity_only: Gate16's specialized signed Walsh parity estimator from 96 allowed action samples.
arms.bayes: Gate17 full 0/1/2/3-parent Bayesian subset averaging with Beta(1,1) integrated counts; same 388-byte persistent raw records but extra posterior scratch/candidate scans, no practical equal-cost claim.
arms.null: Pure fair-coin p=0.5 expected held Brier .25, explicit standard baseline.

budget.runtime: Count gate17 feature-fit comparisons and source elapsed time where available; per-call computation, temporary Bayesian state, and process overhead not equalized, no energy or whole-model cost claims.
budget.cold: Each 388-byte compact model stored/restored twice and predicts exactly for all 8 held action vectors. No native or cross-process long-term checkpoint claim.

scoring.primary: Mean held Brier averaged across 2 contexts x8 withheld actions per seed, then over 48 seeds per family. Per-seed paired normal 95% CI.
scoring.subgroups: For each three-parent cohort, report count and held Brier for source true-parent pattern observed vs never observed in fit actions; subgroup labels diagnostic only, not used by any learner.
scoring.parent_recovery: Exact inferred 3-parent mask counts out of 96 worlds per 3-parent family. No parent ID leakage allowed.
scoring.paired_comparisons: Compare adaptive vs flat memorization baseline, 2-parent truncated, fixed-full, and Bayesian. Preserve negatives and note parity-only specialized advantage when present.

interpretation: If unseen-action gain vs flat passes but fixed full ties, it is only finite 5-bit action-combination generalization under parent-bit coverage, not causal intelligence or structural self-assembly. If any true parent-pattern is missing from fit, no arbitrary Boolean function can uniquely predict its unknown bit without an additional inductive prior. Native acceptance and model continuation remain separately owner-controlled.
